title: StockEventLineDetailDto
description: A single transaction detail row - one stock card line item created by the event.

orderable.description: Resolved orderable (product) of the line item.

lot.description: Resolved lot of the line item, when present.

source.description: Resolved source facility or organization, for receive line items.

sourceFreeText.description: Additional source free text of the movement, when present.

destination.description: Resolved destination facility or organization, for issue line items.

destinationFreeText.description: Additional destination free text of the movement, when present.

quantity.description: Quantity moved by the line item.

occurredDate.description: Occurred date of the line item (ISO date).

reason.description: Reason of the movement, when present.

reasonFreeText.description: Additional reason free text of the movement, when present.

stockOnHand.description: Stock on hand after the operation.

documentNumber.description: Document number of the originating event.

cancellable.description: Whether the line item can still be cancelled, by the same rules as POST /api/stockEvents/{id}/cancel. The STOCK_EVENTS_CANCEL right and the stock on hand left after the cancellation are only checked on cancel.

cancellationError.description: Why the line item cannot be cancelled; null when it can. Same shape as an entry of lineErrors returned by POST /api/stockEvents/{id}/cancel: stockEventLineItemId, messageKey, message (localized) and blockingTransactions (the physical inventories recorded after the movement, when they are the reason). Line items recorded before cancellations were introduced report stockmanagement.error.event.lineItem.recordedBeforeReversal.
